import re,json,html,pathlib
d='products/services/catalogue-agency-prospects/distribution-handoff/raw/'
out={}
for n in ['maze-design','orienteed','dpt']:
  t=pathlib.Path(d+n+'-profile.html').read_text(errors='replace')
  s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>',' ',t,flags=re.S)
  s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
  i=s.find('About')
  hits={k:[s[max(0,m.start()-150):m.start()+200] for m in re.finditer(k,s,re.I)][:3] for k in ['migrat','catalog','product data','Contact','website','Based in','Languages','Price','Starting']}
  links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="(https?://(?!www\.shopify|cdn\.shopify|help\.shopify|apps\.shopify|shopify\.dev|community\.shopify|accounts\.shopify|partners\.shopify)[^"]+)"',t)))[:15]
  out[n]={'len':len(t),'text_head':s[:1500],'hits':hits,'external_links':links}
p=pathlib.Path('products/services/catalogue-agency-prospects/distribution-handoff/profile-extract.json');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False)[:6000])
